purpose: Frozen-checkpoint cross-rate diagnostic for the regional-resolution sweep
sampling: Independent across carriers; nested across rates at each example and mask seed.
aggregation: Pixel SSE is pooled within each mask, then the five mask RMSEs are averaged. Stable-group files explicitly distinguish pooled RMSE and mean per-mask RMSE.

stable_groups.already_measured_at_4: Own-carrier regional measurement present at 4% and 8%.
stable_groups.newly_measured_at_8: No own-carrier regional measurement at 4%; present at 8%.
stable_groups.still_unmeasured_at_8: No own-carrier regional measurement at either rate.

sampling_denominator: Measurement histograms count region-carrier-mask entries over the valid domain, including entries without holdout pixels; they are not pixel-weighted.
pre_softupdate: Recovered algebraically at the same frozen weights from the final regional blend (rho=0.25); this is not a retrained ablation.
data_invariance_checks: Identical graph paths, edge indices, static geometry features, labels, and building masks across input rates.
Identical holdout targets, weights, and within-region squared errors across input rates and evaluation masks.
Nested pixel observation sets and nondecreasing regional observation counts across input rates.
scope: Two single-seed checkpoints at one requested region count. Fixed-checkpoint input interventions do not uniquely isolate encoder, self-anchor, or other anchor effects. Between-checkpoint differences cannot separate training-rate effects from fit variability.
phase1_output: One constant predicted value per region and carrier, scored at heldout pixels.
verification: Recomputed all four five-mask mean RMSEs, scoring counts, stable-group directions, the single-measurement fraction, and all pre-update versus final-score comparisons from the released CSV files.
csv_serialization: UTF-8 with LF line endings. CSV records are unchanged from the diagnostic artifacts.
